arabic text: SHABBIR TERA MAATAM, MOMIN KI NISHANI HAI\nMAATAM KARO SHABBIR KA, HAI ZAINABE DILGIR KA
english translation text: SHABBIR YOU MATAM IS IDENTITY OF MOMIN,\nDO MATAM OF SHABBIR (A.S.), DO MATAM OF ZAINAB (A.S.)

arabic text: BAKSHISH KI ZAMAANAT HAI, JO AANKH ME PAANI HAY
english translation text: OUR TEARS ARE GUARANTEE OF OUR SALVATION

arabic text: YEH DAAGH NAHIN LOGO, HAI MOJIZA MAATAM KA\nSINE PE LIKHI MERE, KERBAL KI KAHANI HAI
english translation text: THIS IS NOT A SCAR ON MY CHEST,\nIT IS MIRACLE OF MATAM,\nOUR HEART HOLDS THE STORY OF KARBALA

arabic text: GHAZI KA ALAM LEKE, BAAZAAR ME AAYEE HAI\nRUDAAD ASEERON KI, DUNIYA KO SUNANI HAI
english translation text: WE ARE ON THE ROAD WITH THE FLAG OF GHAZI (A.S.),\nWE INTEND TO TELL STORY OF PRISONERS TO THE WORLD

arabic text: ZAINAB NE SHURUU KI THI, ZINDAAN ME AZADARI\nSADIYON SE CHALI AAYI, YEH REET PURANI HAI
english translation text: ZAINAB (A.S.) STARTED THE AZADARI IN PRISON,\nWE WILL CARRY ON THIS TRADITION OF CENTURIES

arabic text: AAYI HAI SADAA AB BHI, KARBAL KI FIZAAON SE\nSHABBIR HAQEEQAT ME, ISLAM KA BAANI HAI
english translation text: EVEN TODAY WE HEAR A VOICE FROM KARBALA,\nTHAT INDEED SHABBIR IS FOUNDER OF ISLAM

arabic text: DE PURSAA BAHATAR KA, ZAHRA KE LUTE GHAR KA\nHAR SAAL MUHARRAM ME, YEH YAAD DILANI HAI
english translation text: OFFER CONDOLENCES OF SEVENTY TWO AND OF BIBI ZAHRA’S (A.S.) HOUSEHOLD,\nEVERY YEAR IN MUHARRAM WE WILL REMEMBER THIS TRAGEDY
